messages:
sam_devex: quick note from design review: propose a compact 'tool-chip' row in playground run history to group tool calls and show a tiny schema diff badge. thoughts?

maria_design: like it. ascii mock pls. worried about long tool ids and spacing.

sam_devex: ascii: [Structured] TranslateText v2 · 3 calls · avg 42ms · p95 120ms · schema changes (chev)

noah_eng: grouping +1. show avg+p95, but keep ability to expand to per-call latencies. lazy-load diffs for big runs.

lee_prod: preserve historical schema snapshots. add a one-click revert to previous schema and a toggle to "apply current schema" (opt-in reenact).

ashley_a11y: a11y nits: chips need 2rem hit target, keyboard focus ring, ARIA like "tool invocation group: TranslateText, 3 calls", contrast 4.5:1, and don't use color alone.

maria_design: copy tweak: change "schema changes (chev)" to "schema changes" with chevron icon; badges: "Structured output" / "Unstructured". preserve expand state across pages.

ci-bot: deploy-checks: add unit tests for 0/1/ many tool-calls and long tool ids. failing tests block merge. :robot_face:

sam_devex: captured actions: 1) tool-chip layout + badges, 2) snapshot + expand diff, 3) preserve expand state, 4) keyboard/ARIA & contrast, 5) revert/reenact affordances, 6) throttle UI for +N tools, 7) CI tests. will update prototype and post PNG. thanks!
